name: MADAME OZYMANDIA
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HER: on the bare ground before the table's left side, the client's side (errata 89 C).
note: MADAME OZYMANDIA, behind her round table under the red lantern. No document describes her; she is drawn as an American spiritualist medium of the 1850s (errata 89 B), five poses on magenta generated against Thad (room-16 operation 3), cut at the table top by tools/art/room16-ozymandia.py. BEHIND THE TABLE: `y` is the cut row, not her feet. The crystal ball, the cash box and the tea pot stand in front of her: occlusion plane 1. Present in every act; her Act IV appearance is at Prosperity (doc 04), not here.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for her.

sprite.frameNote: 0 fingertips to her temples, eyes closed · 1 breath (derived) · 2 humming, fingertips at her temples · 3 one hand raised high, pronouncing · 4 one hand held out palm up, for the fee. Breathing on 0 and 1; every `breakEvery` seconds one break (errata 77).
sprite.waistOnNote: The plate row the figure's waist ends on: the table's back edge (y 500-502 either side of the ball; behind the ball's stand at her centre). Nothing of her comes below it: the ball, the strong box and the tea pot stand in front of her (occlusion plane 1). Held by tests/counter-surface.test.mjs against the plate.
sprite.redrawn: Errata 111 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master by cast-unify operation 16 (reference/cast-unify-14.txt), against a picture of the last attempt in this room; cut with its own pixels and a clean edge (tools/art/cast-unify-cut.py --grid 1), registered on the head and on the bottom row (tools/art/bust-register.py --bottom), head matched to the drawing it replaces. Her hands are at her temples: twice drawn resting on the table, they landed on the box and the tea pot that stand in front of her.
